Company Description: For more than 40 years, DAVA Foods has been a trusted supplier of eggs and egg-based solutions to the food industry. Our ambition is clear: to unlock more from the egg and develop a growing portfolio of high-value ingredients for the food industry. Company Description: When Maypro was founded in 1977 by the Japanese entrepreneur Steve Yamada, it was a small company with a big vision — to improve human health and happiness by importing the best-quality nutraceutical ingredients and fine chemicals to the US market from Asia. At the time, the United States had the population to support massive growth of its fledgling dietary supplement industry, but suffered from a dearth of innovative ingredients. Japan, on the other hand, was developing groundbreaking nutraceuticals at breakneck speed, but its small population limited the ingredients’ growth potential. Maypro became the bridge between the two countries. Many of today’s specialty blockbuster ingredients — such as CoQ10, glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate and alpha lipoic acid — were first introduced from Japan to the US market by Maypro. As the United States started to develop proprietary, patented nutraceutical ingredients in the 1990s, the bridge became two-way, with Maypro pioneering the introduction of Citrimax®, Pycnogenol®, Tonalin®, Neopuntia® and Liposan Ultra® and many other products to the Japanese market. Today, Maypro has grown into one of the largest global suppliers of nutraceutical ingredients and fine chemicals, with six strategically located companies in the US, Japan and China and a global staff of over 100. We continue to build global bridges, expanding into Europe and Latin America, and now service hundreds of countries worldwide.

Company Description: Packstyle is a forward-thinking company redefining flexible packaging through research, quality and continuous innovation. Our mission is to make high-performance packaging accessible and efficient, while constantly investing in material development, testing and regulatory compliance. Research & Development drives our evolution. We work on advanced high-barrier and recyclable structures, carry out in-depth performance testing and continuously adapt our solutions to meet the latest national and international food-contact regulations. Our approach is pioneering: we explore new materials, formats and technologies to combine protection, sustainability and design. We chose flexible packaging for its efficiency and reduced environmental impact. Lightweight and space-saving, it lowers transport emissions and helps reduce food waste by extending product shelf life. Every solution is engineered to protect product integrity while minimizing environmental footprint. Our range includes flat pouches and doypacks in multiple sizes. While we are known for short runs starting from 50 pieces, our production capacity also supports larger-scale industrial quantities, ensuring consistent quality and reliability. All materials are certified for food contact and designed with advanced barrier properties to protect against oxygen, moisture and light. We offer recyclable paper, metallised films and transparent films, officially certified (ATICELCA for paper and Interzero for films). To provide measurable and transparent data, Packstyle has conducted a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) analysis on its materials. This scientific evaluation measures environmental impact throughout the entire life cycle, from raw material sourcing to end-of-life, allowing us to benchmark, improve and offer objective data to our clients. Functionality is enhanced by accessories such as resealable zippers for extended freshness and spouts for precise dispensing of liquid or powdered products. Each detail is designed to optimize usability and performance. Digital printing enables fast production, high-definition graphics and full customization without extra setup costs. We manage both small and large runs with short lead times, including multi-graphic productions at no additional charge. Artwork can be uploaded independently or developed with our in-house creative team through the Style My Pack service.
